summary: Practitioner/open-source sweep (2026-11-03) of ~45 pages across Concretum, Quantitativo, Quantpedia, Krueger Algorithms, Delphic Alpha, Databento, Robot Wealth, Carver, QuantConnect, vectorbt PRO, Seasonax and prop-firm cost pages. WebSearch budget was exhausted mid-sweep and several sites blocked fetches (Apex, SSRN, QuantConnect library, NinjaTrader fee table, Quantified Strategies main site, CME fee page, Alpha Architect, Allocate Smartly, Hoffstein, Moontower, Clenow, Hudson & Thames) - those are marked 'not fetched'. Headline findings: (1) The strongest *published, code-backed* futures results found are NOT prop-compatible: short-term basis reversal in commodity calendar spreads (Sharpe 1.42-1.45 net 10 bps, weekly) and multi-day dip buys. (2) Every rigorously held-out intraday result on index/FX CFDs is either sub-cost (Delphic Alpha Atlas: best 1.5 bp/trade; Krueger: 1-3 bps edges vs 1-5 bps round-trip) or an event niche (FTSE rebalance closing-auction short, +11.5 bps/event, t 3.9, ~12 events/yr). (3) The only intraday ES/NQ model with Sharpe >1.5 reported by a practitioner with costs is the Zarattini Noise-Area model (Quantitativo: NQ Sharpe 1.67, portfolio 1.57 at 0.5 tick/trade) - already a CLOSED family and flat 2010-2017. (4) Concretum's 2026 additions are incremental layers (overnight-hybrid exit +0.19 Sharpe gross; fast-alpha execution overlay +0.12 Sharpe net) rather than new edges. (5) A key firm-rule nuance: the futures prop 'trading day' runs from the 18:00 ET reopen to the next afternoon close, so overnight-SESSION holds (18:00->09:30) are allowed; only cross-close holds are banned. Realistic all-in futures costs: ES ~$2.0-2.7/side (+1 tick), MES ~$0.66-0.96/side (+1 tick); prop pass-through round trips ES $3.10-5.00, MES $0.50-1.22. FTMO: forex $3/lot RT, indices $0 commission, crypto 0.0325%/side, swaps nightly (3x Wed), Swing accounts 1:30 leverage with overnight/weekend/news allowed. Honest verdict: no candidate found has a HIGH plausibility of net Sharpe >=1.5 under prop constraints; 4-5 have MEDIUM plausibility as sleeves or in FTMO Swing accounts.

prompt_rules: Treat the futures prop trading day as 18:00 ET reopen to the firm's afternoon flat deadline; overnight-SESSION holds are allowed, cross-close holds are not. Test session-conditional edges separately.

Model futures costs per side as commission + exchange/clearing/NFA + slippage: ES $2.0-2.7 + 1 tick; MES $0.66-0.96 + 1 tick; NQ ~$2.5 + 1-2 ticks; MNQ ~$0.8 + 1 tick. Report break-even bps per trade.
Reject any rule whose gross edge per trade is below 2x round-trip cost before further work; bar-level reversion/breakout edges of 0.2-3 bps are sub-cost (Delphic Atlas, Krueger).
Pre-register every test: rule, instruments, dates, cost model, one untouched holdout (2022+), day-clustered t-stats, Benjamini-Hochberg q across the whole program ledger.
Benchmark each rule against random-market surrogates and placebo days; keep only rules whose real t exceeds the surrogate 95th percentile and whose placebo effect is ~0.
Prefer edges with a forced-flow mechanism (index rebalances, auctions, fixes, rebalancing windows) over pattern-mined ones; the mechanism must predict sign and timing.
For event rules with fewer than 40 trades per year, compute annual dollar contribution at allowed size first; they cannot carry $20k/yr alone and belong only in sleeves.

Build bars from Databento trades with explicit session boundaries and replicate one known result (Noise-Area model on ES: Sharpe ~0.9-1.25) before new tests; provider differences can swing results 3x.
Enter at the next bar's open after the signal bar closes; measure alpha decay by delaying 1 and 5 minutes and drop rules that lose >50% of edge.
Exclude FOMC/CPI/NFP days from breakout systems as a filter only; never trade the announcement itself (Krueger: FOMC days -0.10 R vs quiet +1.19 R).
Use volatility regime (5-day range vs 250-day distribution) and VIX term structure for sizing and gating, never as direction signals.
Apply Carver's speed limit: estimated annual cost must stay below one-third of expected pre-cost Sharpe; compute turnover-implied cost before backtesting.
Spend Databento credits on 1-min OHLCV for ES/NQ/MES/MNQ/CL/GC first; buy only 1-3 months of MBP-1/TBBO to measure spread and depth by hour.
Treat FTMO Swing (1:30 leverage, swap nightly with triple Wednesday, overnight/weekend/news allowed) as the only venue for multi-day holds; standard FTMO and futures props are intraday-only.
Log every test including failures in a ledger; stop a strategy family after three pre-registered failures; never re-test closed families without a stated material difference and holdout.
